summary.headline: Overall health 48/100 - Critical risk
paragraphs: The QRadar deployment (version 7.5.0) comprising 6 managed host(s) is at material operational risk and requires immediate remediation, with an overall health score of 48/100 (grade F) and a critical risk rating.

The assessment identified 6 critical, 14 high, 22 medium and 4 low severity findings. The weakest areas are Performance (9), Applications (42), Deployment (46); strongest areas are Notifications (83), WinCollect (65).
Priority actions: 1) Disk capacity threshold exceeded; 2) Sustained high CPU utilisation; 3) Managed host connectivity problem; 4) EPS license threshold exceeded; 5) High disk I/O latency (await).
highlights: 140 log sources analysed (15 in error, 7 silent) generating 11207 EPS in aggregate.
EPS licence consumption at 108% of 25000 EPS.

top_recommendations.title: Disk capacity threshold exceeded
recommendation: Identify the largest consumers with 'du -shx /store/* | sort -h' and the /store/ariel retention settings.
Review Ariel retention buckets (Admin > Data Retention) and reduce retention for low-value event/flow categories.
Remove stale files in /store/tmp, /storetmp, old backups and large core/heap dumps; rotate /var/log.
Add storage (expand LVM volume, add a Data Node, or offload to a secondary store) and enable Data Node rebalancing.
Configure disk usage notification thresholds to alert at 80% / 90%.
top_recommendations.best_practice: IBM recommends keeping /store below 80% with retention aligned to compliance; never run above 90% as the 95% hard stop halts processing.
top_recommendations.impact: At 95% QRadar stops accepting events and flows (ecs-ec-ingress / hostcontext halts services) and Ariel searches fail; /var/log or / full can crash PostgreSQL and tomcat.
top_recommendations.business_impact: Event collection outage and loss of historical search; recovery requires emergency clean-up.
observations: [qr-ep01] /var/log is 96% full (48.0 GB of 50.0 GB). QRadar also raised 1 related notification(s), e.g. "Disk usage on /store has exceeded 93% on qr-ep01".

top_recommendations.title: Sustained high CPU utilisation
recommendation: Identify the processes with the highest CPU (ecs-ec-ingress, ecs-ep, ariel_proxy_server, postgres, java/tomcat, apps).
Review custom rules (CRE) and expensive custom properties; disable or optimise those that are CPU-heavy.
Redistribute event sources or add an Event/Flow Processor; consider upgrading appliance hardware.
top_recommendations.best_practice: IBM sizing guidance targets sustained CPU below 70% with peaks below 90%.
top_recommendations.impact: Increased search latency, event processing delays and risk of event drops at the pipeline.
top_recommendations.business_impact: Delayed detection and degraded analyst experience.
observations: [qr-console01] Average CPU 88.0% (p95 100.0%, peak 100.0%); saturated (>=90%) in 50.0% of samples.
[qr-ep01] Average CPU 88.0% (p95 100.0%, peak 100.0%); saturated (>=90%) in 45.1% of samples.

top_recommendations.title: Managed host connectivity problem
recommendation: Verify network connectivity and SSH from the Console to the managed host (TCP 22) and that the encryption tunnel (TCP 4333 / 7777) is established.
Check 'hostcontext' and 'tomcat' services on the managed host, system time (NTP) and disk space.
If the host was rebuilt, remove and re-add it, then deploy full configuration.
top_recommendations.best_practice: Monitor managed host status and keep time synchronised across the deployment.
top_recommendations.impact: Configuration cannot be deployed to the host; events/flows from that host may be missing; services may be down.
top_recommendations.business_impact: Partial or complete loss of data from components on that host.
observations: Managed Host Connectivity: Hosts in error/unreachable state: qr-ec01 (10.10.1.22) QRadar also raised 1 related notification(s), e.g. "Managed host qr-ec01 is not responding (hostcontext down)".

top_recommendations.title: EPS license threshold exceeded
recommendation: Review the License Pool Management page (Admin > System Configuration > System and License Management) and confirm EPS allocation per managed host.
Identify the top EPS log sources (Log Activity > Group by Log Source) and filter noisy or low-value events with routing rules, custom event properties or at-source tuning.
Rebalance EPS between event processors, or purchase additional EPS capacity / add an Event Processor.
Enable event coalescing for high-volume, repetitive sources and disable payload storage where not required.
top_recommendations.best_practice: IBM recommends sizing EPS licence at 20-30% above sustained peak and reviewing consumption at least quarterly; avoid sustained operation above 90% of the licensed rate.
top_recommendations.impact: Events above the licensed rate are queued to the temporary 'burst' buffer and, when the buffer is exhausted, are dropped or routed to the 'Dropped Events' log source, causing detection and compliance gaps.
top_recommendations.business_impact: Security telemetry is silently lost during peak periods; offenses may not fire and audit evidence can be incomplete.
observations: EPS: licensed 25000, current 26886, peak 35987 (144% of licence). 12-month forecast 298%. QRadar also raised 1 related notification(s), e.g. "License EPS threshold exceeded: current 28,400 EPS exceeds

top_recommendations.title: High disk I/O latency (await)
recommendation: Review the storage subsystem (SAN/NAS latency, RAID health, cache battery, queue depth, multipath).
Review data retention settings and large scheduled Ariel searches / reports running during ingestion peaks.
Review application storage use (App Framework volumes on /store) and move heavy apps to a dedicated App Host.
For virtual appliances ensure thick-provisioned, SSD-backed datastores and dedicated I/O paths.
top_recommendations.best_practice: IBM storage guidance targets average await < 10 ms for /store (SSD < 2 ms); sustained values above 20 ms indicate a storage bottleneck.
top_recommendations.impact: Slow Ariel writes and searches, ingestion queue growth, delayed offenses and high I/O wait on CPU.
top_recommendations.business_impact: Analysts experience slow searches and late detections; risk of event backlog and drops.
observations: [qr-console01] Storage latency on dev8-0: await avg 47.6 ms (peak 70 ms); r_await 0.0 ms, w_await 0.0 ms; avgqu-sz 5.95.
[qr-ep01] Storage latency on dev8-0: await avg 45.4 ms (peak 70 ms); r_await 0.0 ms, w_await 0.0 ms; avgqu-sz 5.67.

top_recommendations.title: High CPU I/O wait
recommendation: Review storage subsystem health and latency.
Reduce concurrent heavy Ariel searches/reports; review retention.
top_recommendations.best_practice: Sustained iowait above 10% is a sign of storage contention.
top_recommendations.impact: Indicates storage latency or contention; delays event commit and search execution.

top_recommendations.title: WinCollect agents disconnected / communication problems
recommendation: Verify the agent service is running and that TCP 8413 (agent management) and the event destination port (TCP/UDP 514 or 6514 TLS) are reachable.
Check certificate/token validity for managed agents and the destination definition in the WinCollect app.
Review the agent's WinCollect.log for connection and certificate errors and restart the service if required.
top_recommendations.best_practice: IBM recommends WinCollect agents in managed mode with TLS-secured syslog to a dedicated Event Collector; monitor agent heartbeats centrally.
top_recommendations.impact: Windows event logs from the affected hosts are not forwarded; the agents may buffer to disk and later overflow.
top_recommendations.business_impact: No visibility of Windows authentication, privilege and process activity on affected servers.
observations: 8 of 95 WinCollect agents (8.4%) are disconnected, silent or in error. QRadar also raised 1 related notification(s), e.g. "WinCollect agents disconnected: 12 agents have not checked in".
2 configuration issue(s) and 0 deployment issue(s) detected.

top_recommendations.title: Application memory pressure
recommendation: Raise the container memory limit if the host has capacity.
Redistribute applications across hosts or add an App Host.
top_recommendations.best_practice: Keep application memory usage below 80% of the limit.
top_recommendations.impact: Risk of OOM kills and restart loops, degraded application responsiveness.
observations: Pulse 2.2.1 on qr-apphost01: Memory at 96% of limit
User Behavior Analytics 4.1.2 on qr-apphost01: Memory at 44% of limit

top_recommendations.title: DSM / protocol error on log sources
recommendation: Open the log source in Log Source Management and review the status message and the protocol-specific diagnostics (Test Connection).
Verify credentials, firewall rules and certificate validity for the integration; update the DSM and protocol RPMs through Auto Update.
Resolve duplicate / misconfigured log source identifiers if the same device is mapped twice.
top_recommendations.best_practice: Monitor log source status centrally and remediate ERROR sources within 5 business days; use the Log Source Management app's bulk tools.
top_recommendations.impact: Events from the affected log source are missing, delayed or incorrectly normalised.
top_recommendations.business_impact: Monitoring gap for the affected technology.
observations: 15 of 140 log sources (10.7%) are in ERROR state.

top_recommendations.title: Event parsing errors / unparsed events
recommendation: Use Log Activity > filter 'Log Source Type = Unknown' / 'Event Name = Unknown' to identify the sources.
Install the correct DSM and latest DSM/protocol Auto Update; confirm the log source type and protocol settings.
Where no DSM exists, use the DSM Editor / Universal DSM with LEEF/CEF formatting.
Review 'Parsing Issues' notifications and /var/log/qradar.error for exceptions.
top_recommendations.best_practice: Keep Unknown/Stored events below 1% of total; review parsing health monthly using the Log Source Management app.
top_recommendations.impact: Events are stored with generic categories, cannot be used in CRE rules and searches, and consume licence and storage without security value.
top_recommendations.business_impact: Detections and compliance reports miss data from the affected sources.
observations: 12 log source(s) are typed as Unknown/Generic, indicating missing or incorrect DSM mapping. QRadar also raised 1 related notification(s), e.g. "Events were not parsed: Unknown log source type for 14 s
